skill.desc: Heals 3-5 units in your lineup based on 15% of Tsunade's base Ninjutsu stat and cancels 1 <font color="#4dc831">Debuff</font>. After Tsunade is revived via <font color="#4dc831">Reserve Seal</font>, this skill heals 7-9 units in the ally field instead.

skill.name: Reserve Seal
skill.desc: Tsunade is <font color="#4dc831">immune to Debuffs</font>. Units causing Taijutsu damage to Tsunade will have a 45% chance to suffer from <font color="#4dc831">Chaos</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Weakness</font>. If Tsunade is defeated for the first time in a battle, revives with 100% <font color="#4dc831">HP</font>, gains <font color="#4dc831">Summoning Jutsu - Small Katsuyu</font> and the chance to cause <font color="#4dc831">Chaos</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Weakness</font> becomes 75%.

skill.name: The Legendary Sannin
skill.desc: Whenever <font color="#4dc831">Konoha</font> ninjas in your lineup receives an Extra Standard Attack, Tsunade also receives an Extra Standard Attack (up to 3 per round). While Tsunade is alive, <font color="#4dc831">Konoha</font> ninjas in your lineup except herself cannot be defeated by the first <font color="#4dc831">Mystery</font> damage received every round.

skill.name: Giant Katsuyu - Healing
skill.desc: At the end of round 1, 2 and 3, heals up to 9 units in the ally field based on 25% of Tsunade's base Ninjutsu stats and cancels all <font color="#4dc831">Debuffs</font>, then dispels all <font color="#4dc831">Ignition</font> she currently has. After Tsunade is revived via <font color="#4dc831">Reserve Seal</font>, this skill instead will be executed as a <font color="#4dc831">Mystery</font> skill whenever Tsunade selects an ally unit while executing her Mystery.

skill.name: Giant Katsuyu - Acid Shot
skill.desc: Causes damage, <font color="#4dc831">Suppress Immunity</font> until the end of the next round, <font color="#4dc831">Corrosion</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Melt</font> to up to 7 units in the opponent's field.
